$comment: Permission scope for dispatcher-spawned workers (tools/dispatcher/src/worker-routing.mjs invokes `claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits --permission-prompts none`, which reads this file automatically). Rules are enforced by Claude Code's own harness, not by the model choosing to comply -- see docs/operators/local-execution.md 'Security model'. Evaluation order is deny, then ask, then allow; the first match wins and a deny rule cannot be carved out by a more specific allow. File-permission checks (for Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, and MultiEdit alike) are matched against Edit(path)/Read(path) rules only -- a path-scoped Write(path) rule is a silent no-op, so this file uses Edit(path) for every file-write restriction. This is a defense-in-depth layer: the primary enforcement boundary for anything touching master is the GitHub branch ruleset (verified to reject a direct push independent of any agent's behavior), not this file. See MOV-116 (docs/planning/decision-log.md Stage 9b) for the planned upgrade to a separately-scoped worker credential.
